scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “The normalized-volume gap in dimension four” (preprints/The-normalized-volume-gap-in-dimension-four-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 037 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d58101115e4bf4f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let x ∈ X be a singular closed point of a normal complex algebraic variety of dimension four. Suppose that KX is Q-Cartier and that X is klt near x, with boundary zero. Then c vol(x, X) ≤ 162. Equality holds if and only if the analytic germ (X, x) is isomorphic to n z2 0 + z2 1 + z2 2 + z2 3 + z2 4 = 0 o ⊂ C5 , 0  .
